crossRefs.note: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in…
that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will…
The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

translations.web: He spoke three thousand proverbs; and his songs numbered one thousand five.
translations.bsb: Solomon composed three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered a thousand and five.
translations.kjv: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
translations.asv: And he spake three thousand proverbs; and his songs were a thousand and five.
